parts:
Hey,

So I've been working on setting up Shiny Server on DigitalOcean, a cloud virtual server site, which is running CentOS 6.5 x64. I've followed the Shiny Server Admin Guide (though I had to resort to other tutorials for parts) to install R, Shiny Server, Node.js, etc., and I have an app that will run on a local machine with runapp(). My question seems to be similar to this post:
https://groups.google.com/forum/#!searchin/shiny-discuss/server/shiny-discuss/GWd1u5emDH4/dr8vkD2a_SMJ

in that I'm having trouble setting the path to my app and getting it to run (and I'm a beginner as well). Is the idea to make a directory on the server, then send the app along with all the associated .r files to it, then change the path in the shiny-server config file? If I'm slightly off here, would someone be kind enough to walk me through how this would be done? 

A follow up question, though I think it's related, is determining how (or if) I can point a domain to the server IP. I'm using Reclaim Hosting for a url, which is pointed to the DigitalOcean server IP, but is there something else in the shiny-server config file that needs to be changed? 

I would greatly appreciate any and all advice anyone can give me. Thanks very much!

-Chandler
